hypotheses.Insensitive/flat: Practical-equivalence test: total RMSE ratio and log-log slope stay below configured thresholds.
hypotheses.SNR-improving: Negative log-log slope and lower high-step RMSE than low-step RMSE.
hypotheses.Power-law-like: Positive log-log slope with high log-log R2 and no saturation/erratic flags.
hypotheses.Monotone growth: Mostly monotone positive deterioration with acceptable, but not strict, log-log support.
hypotheses.Saturation/plateau: High-step plateau and/or frequency-bound hit rate exceeds threshold.
hypotheses.Erratic: Multiple large reversals or weak smooth-model support; do not claim a law.
